data.body: Close-gate classification correction: this ticket was created as a bug, but its approved plan and acceptance criteria are strictly an investigation/RCA deliverable; implementation was explicitly conditional only for missing observability, and existing logs proved sufficient. The completion verifier correctly refused to certify that CI latency itself is already repaired. Reclassifying this record to task so closure means the RCA/remediation decomposition is complete, while the seven linked live tickets continue to own the actual fixes.
